propositions: E2 builds a deterministic seeded-defect mutant corpus and supporting harness infrastructure (mutation-assembly, benchmark driver, pure counting helpers, pre-registered thresholds, golden tests) as WIP on branch calib/6982-e2, intentionally not landed on main.

The live ~100-run LLM batch baseline sweep (review_plan evaluation + e2_baseline.json / e2_run_validity.json outputs) is permanently rejected on cost and superseded by d8a5's standing criterion_effectiveness.py recorder which accumulates detection/blocking-FP signal from real production reviews at zero marginal LLM cost.

The mutant corpus covers 5 defect classes (absent capability, layer-cake split, consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge, unnecessary mechanism, untagged operational AC) with ≥10 mutants per class (except class 5 with N≥5) paired to unmutated controls, each carrying mutation_op and mutation_diff metadata.
Store isolation is implemented by construction: the harness clones the tickets store locally with its own .git directory, preventing contamination of the real tracker.
Counting helpers e2_counting.py (classify_pair and run_validity) enforce run-validity guard: returns non-zero and produces no baseline output when any class exceeds 0.20 INDETERMINATE rate.
History-mining baseline approach is dead due to stranded history (~4 plan-v3 sidecar baselines vs ~200 needed after impact_model_version bump).
